claim: Original host public-model SHA256 and BLAKE3 were fed from the same full input stream; evidence rechecked without model rehash.
source_mechanism: One Files.newInputStream loop calls blake3.update and sha256.update with identical buffer/offset/count, sums total, checks full1590475744 bytes and pinned SHA256 before emitting final BLAKE3.

model.classification: host public-model identity; not device benchmark

limitations: Host identity is the old5ae observation, not fresh device evidence.
Full device model SHA256 and size plus isolated-service verification remain required.
BLAKE3 implementation provenance is preserved; no new independent algorithm/vector execution is claimed.
